issues.description: preview_fn contract is unspecified: no signature, postcondition, or error semantics
issues.detail: Docs introduce preview_fn without stating required signature (zero-arg?), whether it must be pure, what node.preview() returns when absent, or how exceptions propagate. Best-practice item 5 punts with 'wrap in try/except if needed' instead of defining failure semantics. Pin the signature, return shape, and error contract before this leaves experimental.

issues.description: meta dict overloads renderer config and opaque metadata under one untyped channel
issues.detail: The same meta carries Mermaid renderer directives, a Kedro-Viz textStyle CSS bag, and arbitrary user metadata. Docs admit meta has 'two purposes'. This conflates rendering hints with descriptive context, leaks renderer concerns into the abstraction, and forces readers to guess reserved keys. Separate render_config from meta or at least document reserved keys.

issues.description: Closure 'data context' example contradicts its framing and hides a late-binding hazard
issues.detail: The section claims to show preview functions accessing data context but actually closes over a hardcoded sample_data literal at pipeline-construction time. It also omits the warning that mutation of the captured object will silently alter preview output. Either show real catalog loading inside preview_fn or drop the section, and call out the binding precondition.

issues.description: Preview type family lacks a written supertype contract and per-subtype preconditions
issues.detail: JsonPreview, TablePreview, PlotlyPreview, MermaidPreview, ImagePreview, TextPreview, CustomPreview are introduced by example with no stated supertype contract: required fields, allowed content types, to_dict() guarantees. TablePreview's stronger list[dict] precondition is buried in a Note. Add an explicit Preview ADT section with per-subtype content schemas before the per-type sections.

issues.description: CustomPreview renderer_key leaks Kedro-Viz frontend coupling without specified ownership
issues.detail: CustomPreview is described as identifying a frontend component via renderer_key, making the backend node API depend on a Kedro-Viz registry that is nowhere specified. Define who owns the renderer_key namespace, what happens on unknown keys (error or no-op), and whether the contract is stable. Otherwise this is a leaky abstraction across the kedro/kedro-viz boundary.

issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable code after return and uses obscure node retrieval
issues.detail: The data-URI alternative is written as commented code below an unconditional return, so copy-paste readers get only the URL form. Separately, basic usage uses `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` where `pipeline.nodes[0]` or a named lookup would teach the right idiom. Split alternatives into separate functions and prefer the obvious retrieval form.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a docs-only PR that is readable but underspecified. The dominant concern across reviewers is missing contracts: preview_fn has no documented signature, return shape, or error semantics, and the Preview subtype family is taught by example with no supertype ADT or per-subtype preconditions. The meta dict is flagged by three reviewers as overloading renderer config with opaque metadata, and CustomPreview leaks a Kedro-Viz frontend coupling through an unspecified renderer_key namespace. Two examples teach bad patterns — a closure that contradicts its own 'data context' framing, and unreachable code after a return — which should be fixed before this experimental feature is broadly adopted.
